gloss: to jump down; to jump off

definitions.gloss: to jump down; to jump off
definitions.explanation: To leap from a height to a lower place.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{木|き}から{飛|と}び{降|お}りた。
examples.english: The child jumped down from the tree.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}が{止|と}まる{前|まえ}に{飛|と}び{降|お}りてはいけない。
examples.english: You must not jump off before the train stops.

examples.japanese: {屋根|やね}から{飛|と}び{降|お}りるのは{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: Jumping off the roof is dangerous.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{飛|と}び{降|お}りる → {飛|と}び{降|お}りない (negative)
・{飛|と}び{降|お}りる → {飛|と}び{降|お}りて (te-form)
・{飛|と}び{降|お}りる → {飛|と}び{降|お}りた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {飛|と}ぶ (to fly, to jump) + {降|お}りる (to descend, to get off)

USAGE:
・〜から{飛|と}び{降|お}りる (to jump down from ~)

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
・{飛|と}び{乗|の}る - to jump onto
・{飛|と}び{込|こ}む - to jump/dive in
・{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる - to jump up
・{飛|と}び{出|だ}す - to jump out
